issue_context.title: [Feature] ignoreOrder option for toHaveText
issue_context.body:
Let us know what functionality you'd like to see in Playwright and what your use case is.
Do you think others might benefit from this as well?

I would like to be able to assert with a locator that returns a list and not care about the order
`await expect(locator).toHaveText([1, 3, 2], ignoreOrder: true)`
comments: Re-opening.  Suggestion to use toContainText is not working.  Still cares about order of list
@pavelfeldman Any news on that? How may we test that list contains text without order?

#### Why was this issue closed?

Thank you for your involvement. This issue was closed due to limited engagement (upvotes/activity), lack of recent activity, and insufficient actionability. To maintain a manageable database, we prioritize issues based on these factors.

If you disagree with this closure, please open a new issue and reference this one. More support or clarity on its necessity may prompt a review. Your understanding and cooperation are appreciated.

review_comments: I'd just `sort()` if the order does not matter, and use the same code as before.
